units.rawText: Things I want to do? ...Worry not, Professor, I've no mind to do anything other than follow you.
units.displayText: Things I want to do? ...Worry not, Professor, I've no mind to do anything other than follow you.

spans.text: Things I want to do? ...Worry not, Professor, I've no mind to do anything other than follow you.

units.rawText: I was once forced into the shadows by the virtue of my status as an assassin, but you've brought me into the light.
units.displayText: I was once forced into the shadows by the virtue of my status as an assassin, but you've brought me into the light.

spans.text: I was once forced into the shadows by the virtue of my status as an assassin, but you've brought me into the light.

units.rawText: I know well what I am doing. I obey not the orders of another, but the voice inside my heart.
units.displayText: I know well what I am doing. I obey not the orders of another, but the voice inside my heart.

spans.text: I know well what I am doing. I obey not the orders of another, but the voice inside my heart.

units.rawText: All that I wish is to keep you safe and sound, no matter what circumstances you find yourself in.
units.displayText: All that I wish is to keep you safe and sound, no matter what circumstances you find yourself in.
